items.text: Rams WR Puka Nacua officially is active today vs. the Raiders despite calf injury; earlier optimistic reports held.
items.why: Feeling better Saturday; no setbacks; McVay optimistic on minor calf.
items.implication: Full or near-full workload expected as WR1; high fantasy upside confirmed.
items.opportunity: Primary target share, routes, red-zone for LAR.

items.text: Jets RB Breece Hall officially inactive; was unlikely after limited practice returning from quad strain, may have worked out but too early.
items.why: Quad strain; not full participant; sources say unlikely.
items.implication: Jets RBs elevated; handcuff/backup opportunity expands.
items.opportunity: Increased carries/snaps for remaining Jets backs.

items.text: Weekend summary: GTD Mike Washington; GTD/opt Puka; GTD/pess Breece; IN Jacobs/Coleman/Kirk/Mason/Dell/Sampson; EXPECTED Saquon; OUT Lamar/DeVonta/Wicks. Projections updated.
items.implication: Direct start/sit and DFS pivots; beneficiaries locked for OUTs.
items.opportunity: Role expansions for backups/handcuffs of OUT/INACTIVE.

items.text: Lamar Jackson has been downgraded to out for Sunday’s game against the Bengals with a high ankle sprain; Tyler Huntley starts again.
items.why: High ankle sprain; ruled out Saturday.
items.implication: Huntley starts; elevated opportunity for Ravens pass-catchers like Zay Flowers in volume.
items.opportunity: Increased targets/snaps for Flowers, Andrews, Likely with backup QB.

items.text: Christian McCaffrey to the locker room (thigh), then returned; was questionable to return mid-game.
items.implication: Monitor for limited snaps post-return; 49ers WR outs still boost receiving.

items.text: Bucs QB Baker Mayfield active/returns after missing games (thumb); Emeka Egbuka inactive.
items.implication: Bucs offense boosted; Egbuka OUT elevates other WRs/Godwin.

items.text: Saquon Barkley EXPECTED TO PLAY (questionable but expected); DeVonta/Wicks OUT creates more volume potential.
items.implication: Strong RB1 start with WR outs boosting checkdowns/goal-line.
items.opportunity: High snap share, carries, targets in two-minute/red-zone.

items.text: IN: Jordan Mason, Christian Kirk (activated), Jonah Coleman, Dylan Sampson among others expected/active.
items.implication: Mason RB opportunity MIN; Kirk WR depth SF amid outs; Coleman Broncos RB upside.

items.text: Giants RB Cam Skattebo expected to resume lead back role vs Texans; JJ McCarthy long leash. Tallied 124 yards on 17 carries + TD.
items.implication: Strong RB2/flex with volume; confirmed by production.
items.conflict: Berry had as hate pre-game tough matchup.

items.text: Packers activated RB Josh Jacobs to active roster from exempt; expected to play and returns to field.
items.implication: Lead back role resumes; monitor snap share after absence.
items.opportunity: Primary carries, goal-line; possible committee initially.

items.text: Texans officially activated WR Tank Dell to active roster; set to return Sunday for first NFL action in almost two years.
items.implication: Immediate WR depth/target competition in HOU; monitor role vs Nico Collins.
items.opportunity: Routes/targets in slot/outside; potential breakout if featured.

items.text: Eagles ruled out WR DeVonta Smith and Dontayvion Wicks for Monday night vs Dallas.
items.why: Injuries; official ruling via team report.
items.implication: Elevated target share for remaining Eagles pass-catchers; Saquon still expected.
items.opportunity: More routes/targets for Goedert, any other WRs; possible CMC-like usage boost if any.

items.text: Status of Lamar (ankle), Puka (calf), Breece (quad) crucial to Sunday DFS main slate. Sneaky scratches: Brian Robinson, Jahwar Jordan, Tyler Warren, Emeka Egbuka. Projections updated on latest news. Tempted by CMC slot WR usage amid 49ers WR outs despite usual skepticism.
items.why: Injury leverage and 49ers WR injuries (Evans/Samuel OUT) create unique CMC receiving upside with Kaelon Black.
items.implication: Pivot DFS builds; fade scratched; buy CMC receiving if confirmed.
items.opportunity: CMC routes/targets in slot; Egbuka OUT boosts other TB WRs.
items.conflict: Rarely trusts RB-as-WR but situation extreme.

items.text: Broncos CB Pat Surtain inactive (ankle); unlikely but chance next week.
items.implication: Softer secondary for ARI pass-catchers (MHJ, Wilson, McBride).

items.text: Sneaky important scratch Emeka Egbuka (among others like BRob, Warren); OUT confirmed.
items.opportunity: Elevated routes for remaining Bucs WRs.

items.text: Loves A.J. Brown (usage/matchup vs CHI), Tucker Kraft (TE buffet vs DET allowing many TE TDs/points), volume RBs like Jaylen Warren, Chuba Hubbard, Bucky Irving. Coleman should be 100% rostered as future Broncos RB1.
items.why: Usage + soft matchups (Bears/Lions TE/RB friendly); Coleman long-term standout.
items.implication: Start with confidence; roster Coleman immediately.
items.opportunity: High snap/target/carry shares in favorable spots.

items.text: Hates Rome Odunze (Gonzalez shadow, outside targets), Josh Downs, Travis Kelce (tough D), Josh Jacobs (post-layoff workload questions). Also Cam Skattebo tough spot.
items.why: Shadow coverage, tough matchups, role/layoff uncertainty.
items.implication: Sit or fade in tough spots; Jacobs monitor snaps.
items.opportunity: Limited routes for Odunze; capped Jacobs early.
